newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Thursday estimate 100,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Thursday estimate 100,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Thursday were 100,000 head, compared with 115,000 a week ago and 110,000 a year ago. Wednesday's actual was zero due to the Christmas holiday, compared with 93,000 the previous week and 114,000 a year ago.

Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts were steady to $0.50 per cwt higher than midsession Tuesday. Trade was slow for moderate to strong demand and light to moderate offerings.

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct carcass yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
